notes: A card that asks you something can now be rolled out of the way: press Minimize, top-right of the card, and it collapses to one line along the bottom saying what is waiting. Nothing is answered or lost — anything you typed into the card is still there when you press Show it.

The app now knows the DBA's two SQL standards and ships them with itself. Any script that creates or alters a table or a column gets the --@diagram tag and the MS_Description blocks before you see it.

For stored procedures, the TRY...CATCH / usp_LogException framework is applied only on the release lines that carry it — the app tells you which line the script targets and asks you, rather than guessing. A 'no' is written into the pull request text so a reviewer does not read it as an oversight.
It no longer comments the code it changes. The explanation belongs in the RCA, not in the diff. Comments the build needs, and a comment your change made wrong, are still handled.
Includes 2.14.0, which fixed a 2.13.0 that could not get past its own start screen, and put your real plan usage (the /usage figure) in the strip.
